units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|As you walk through the spaceport, you see a large crowd gathered outside a small pub, and hear the unmistakable music of There Might Be Riots from inside. The concert seems to be just winding down. Do you want to wait around and say hello to them?|999|0
units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, you see a large crowd gathered outside a small pub, and hear the unmistakable music of There Might Be Riots from inside. The concert seems to be just winding down. Do you want to wait around and say hello to them?
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, vedi una grande folla radunata fuori da un piccolo pub, e senti provenire dall'interno l'inconfondibile musica dei There Might Be Riots. Il concerto sembra appena in fase di chiusura. Vuoi aspettare per salutarli?

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	(Okay.)|1001|0
units.english: (Okay.)
units.italian: (Va bene.)

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	(Not right now.)|1002|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"<first>!" says Ulrich, when they see you. "What luck! We're doing a concert tonight on landing pad ninety-four, part of our 'Trouble on the Tarmac Tour.' We're going to need a lift to <planet> right after the concert. Or possibly in the middle of it. Can you help us out?"|1004|0
units.english: "<first>!" says Ulrich, when they see you. "What luck! We're doing a concert tonight on landing pad ninety-four, part of our 'Trouble on the Tarmac Tour.' We're going to need a lift to <planet> right after the concert. Or possibly in the middle of it. Can you help us out?"
units.italian: "<first>!" dice Ulrich, quando ti vede. "Che fortuna! Stasera facciamo un concerto sulla piazzola di atterraggio novantaquattro, parte del nostro 'Trouble on the Tarmac Tour'. Avremo bisogno di un passaggio per <planet> subito dopo il concerto. O magari nel bel mezzo. Ci dai una mano?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Okay. But why the hurry to leave?"|1006|0
units.english: "Okay. But why the hurry to leave?"
units.italian: "Va bene. Ma perché tutta questa fretta di andare via?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Sorry, I've got other plans."|1008|0
units.english: "Sorry, I've got other plans."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ho altri piani."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Please," he says, "I'm serious. You'll be saving our skins. Whatever else you've got, it's not this important."|1009|0
units.english: "Please," he says, "I'm serious. You'll be saving our skins. Whatever else you've got, it's not this important."
units.italian: "Ti prego," dice, "sono serio. Ci salverai la pelle. Qualunque altra cosa tu abbia da fare, non è così importante."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Okay, I'll do it. Why's it so urgent?"|1011|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll do it. Why's it so urgent?"
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio. Perché è così urgente?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Sorry, I really don't want to work with you guys anymore."|1012|0
units.english: "Sorry, I really don't want to work with you guys anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, davvero non voglio più lavorare con voi."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"You'll see," he says. "You should park your ship right behind us in case the natives get restless and we need to skedaddle."|1015|0
units.english: "You'll see," he says. "You should park your ship right behind us in case the natives get restless and we need to skedaddle."
units.italian: "Lo vedrai," dice. "Parcheggia la nave dietro di noi, nel caso i locali si innervosiscano e dobbiamo svignarcela."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	With some trepidation, you sit by the hatchway of your ship and watch as the band sets up directly outside it and the concert begins. Nothing seems out of the ordinary until the band introduces a song called "Gluttony," and you can feel a sudden tension fill the air. The Syndicate security guards, who until now have been standing at the periphery of the landing pad, begin to disperse themselves throughout the crowd.|1016|0
units.english: With some trepidation, you sit by the hatchway of your ship and watch as the band sets up directly outside it and the concert begins. Nothing seems out of the ordinary until the band introduces a song called "Gluttony," and you can feel a sudden tension fill the air. The Syndicate security guards, who until now have been standing at the periphery of the landing pad, begin to disperse themselves throughout the crowd.
units.italian: Con una certa inquietudine, ti siedi accanto al portello della nave e guardi la band sistemarsi proprio lì fuori mentre il concerto comincia. Niente sembra fuori dall'ordinario finché la band non presenta una canzone intitolata "Gluttony", e senti una tensione improvvisa riempire l'aria. Le guardie di sicurezza del Sindacato, che finora erano rimaste ai margini della piazzola di atterraggio, cominciano a disperdersi tra la folla.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	It's a song about a man who will die if he ever stops eating, so he eats more and more and grows bigger and bigger. A second after you realize that the whole thing is a thinly veiled critique of the Syndicate, a group up front unrolls a banner that reads "End Wage Slavery!" and begins shouting and chanting slogans. As the band plays on, there is some sort of scuffle at the back of the crowd, and then you see stun guns begin to flash, and rising plumes of what you would guess is tear gas.|1017|0
units.english: It's a song about a man who will die if he ever stops eating, so he eats more and more and grows bigger and bigger. A second after you realize that the whole thing is a thinly veiled critique of the Syndicate, a group up front unrolls a banner that reads "End Wage Slavery!" and begins shouting and chanting slogans. As the band plays on, there is some sort of scuffle at the back of the crowd, and then you see stun guns begin to flash, and rising plumes of what you would guess is tear gas.
units.italian: È una canzone su un uomo che morirà se mai smetterà di mangiare, così mangia sempre di più e diventa sempre più grande. Un secondo dopo aver capito che il tutto è una critica appena velata al Sindacato, un gruppo in prima fila srotola uno striscione che recita "Fine della schiavitù salariale!" e comincia a gridare e a scandire slogan. Mentre la band continua a suonare, succede una specie di zuffa in fondo alla folla, e poi vedi lampeggiare le pistole stordenti e alzarsi sbuffi di quello che immagini sia gas lacrimogeno.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	As the demonstrators are driven away, a group of guards approach you. "What is your connection to these musicians?" they ask.|1018|0
units.english: As the demonstrators are driven away, a group of guards approach you. "What is your connection to these musicians?" they ask.
units.italian: Mentre i manifestanti vengono allontanati, un gruppo di guardie si avvicina a te. "Che legame ha con questi musicisti?" chiedono.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"I'm just their transport. They're paying me to carry them to their next destination."|1020|0
units.english: "I'm just their transport. They're paying me to carry them to their next destination."
units.italian: "Sono solo il loro trasporto. Mi pagano per portarli alla loro prossima destinazione."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"They're friends of mine. Why? They haven't done anything illegal, that I can see."|1022|0
units.english: "They're friends of mine. Why? They haven't done anything illegal, that I can see."
units.italian: "Sono amici miei. Perché? Non hanno fatto nulla di illegale, da quanto vedo."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Be careful what friends you choose," says the guard, "or you might find that no one in this sector will offer you any jobs. Now, get them packed up and get out of here." You have no choice but to leave the planet immediately...|1023|0
units.english: "Be careful what friends you choose," says the guard, "or you might find that no one in this sector will offer you any jobs. Now, get them packed up and get out of here." You have no choice but to leave the planet immediately...
units.italian: "Stai attento a quali amici scegli," dice la guardia, "o potresti scoprire che in questo settore nessuno ti offrirà più lavoro. Ora, falli fare i bagagli e vattene da qui." Non hai altra scelta che lasciare il pianeta immediatamente...

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Then I suggest you do your job and transport them. Immediately." The guards leave. As soon as the band is packed up, you leave the planet...|1026|0
units.english: "Then I suggest you do your job and transport them. Immediately." The guards leave. As soon as the band is packed up, you leave the planet...
units.italian: "Allora ti suggerisco di fare il tuo lavoro e di trasportarli. Immediatamente." Le guardie si allontanano. Appena la band ha finito di caricare, lasci il pianeta...

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|dialog|1030|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the band and their supplies has not arrived yet. Better depart and wait for your escorts to enter the system.
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta che porta la band e le sue attrezzature non è ancora arrivata. Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte entrino nel sistema.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|As generous as before, the band pays you generously: <payment>. "Where will you be going next, from here?" you ask.|1035|0
units.english: As generous as before, the band pays you generously: <payment>. "Where will you be going next, from here?" you ask.
units.italian: Generosa come prima, la band ti paga profumatamente: <payment>. "Dove andrete adesso, da qui?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Who knows," says Ulrich. "Our music has taken us throughout human space, and beyond."|1036|0
units.english: "Who knows," says Ulrich. "Our music has taken us throughout human space, and beyond."
units.italian: "Chissà," dice Ulrich. "La nostra musica ci ha portato in tutto lo spazio umano, e oltre."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"What do you mean, 'beyond' human space?"|1038|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'beyond' human space?"
units.italian: "In che senso, 'oltre' lo spazio umano?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"Well, I'll look forward to the next time we meet."|1039|0
units.english: "Well, I'll look forward to the next time we meet."
units.italian: "Beh, non vedo l'ora della prossima volta che ci incontreremo."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	Ulrich launches into a story. "Years ago when the band was young and we had a month off in between gigs, we found an old gray merchant captain with a glass eye and asked him to transport us to one of the Paradise worlds for an extended 'drug vacation,' if you know what I mean. He said, 'Boys, why don't you leave the drugs behind, and I'll take you on a real mind-altering trip,' and a few days later we were playing a concert on this world where the people were giant squirrels. They loved our music, too. Never did find anyone who could take us back there, though."|1041|0
units.english: Ulrich launches into a story. "Years ago when the band was young and we had a month off in between gigs, we found an old gray merchant captain with a glass eye and asked him to transport us to one of the Paradise worlds for an extended 'drug vacation,' if you know what I mean. He said, 'Boys, why don't you leave the drugs behind, and I'll take you on a real mind-altering trip,' and a few days later we were playing a concert on this world where the people were giant squirrels. They loved our music, too. Never did find anyone who could take us back there, though."
units.italian: Ulrich parte con un racconto. "Anni fa, quando la band era giovane e avevamo un mese libero tra un concerto e l'altro, trovammo un vecchio capitano mercantile grigio con un occhio di vetro e gli chiedemmo di portarci su uno dei Mondi Paradisiaci per una lunga 'vacanza di droga', se mi capisci. Lui disse: 'Ragazzi, perché non lasciate perdere la droga e vi porto in un vero viaggio che vi cambia la mente', e pochi giorni dopo suonavamo in concerto su questo mondo dove gli abitanti erano scoiattoli giganti. Anche a loro è piaciuta la nostra musica. Però non abbiamo mai trovato nessuno che potesse riportarci lì."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	You're tempted to laugh, but he sounds serious. "Well," you say, "if I ever find a planet of intelligent squirrels, I'll be glad to take you guys there." You help them to unload their stuff, and say goodbye for now.|1044|0
units.english: You're tempted to laugh, but he sounds serious. "Well," you say, "if I ever find a planet of intelligent squirrels, I'll be glad to take you guys there." You help them to unload their stuff, and say goodbye for now.
units.italian: Sei tentato di ridere, ma lui sembra serio. "Beh," dici, "se mai troverò un pianeta di scoiattoli intelligenti, sarò felice di portarvi lì." Li aiuti a scaricare le loro cose e vi salutate per ora.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 2|	"It sounds like you were visiting Hai space," you say, and you describe the aliens who live beyond the wormhole. "Yeah, that would be them," says Ulrich. "I'd love to go back there some time, but for now we have commitments closer to home." You help them to unload their stuff, and say goodbye for now.|1049|0
units.english: "It sounds like you were visiting Hai space," you say, and you describe the aliens who live beyond the wormhole. "Yeah, that would be them," says Ulrich. "I'd love to go back there some time, but for now we have commitments closer to home." You help them to unload their stuff, and say goodbye for now.
units.italian: "Mi sembra che steste visitando lo spazio degli Hai," dici, e descrivi gli alieni che vivono oltre il wormhole. "Sì, saranno stati loro," dice Ulrich. "Mi piacerebbe tornarci, prima o poi, ma per ora abbiamo impegni più vicini a casa." Li aiuti a scaricare le loro cose e vi salutate per ora.

units.english: Transport band to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta la band su <planet>

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|description|1055|0
units.english: Give the band "There Might Be Riots" a ride to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta la band "There Might Be Riots" fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|As you walk through the spaceport, you see a distinctive group of people lugging a collection of instruments: the band There Might Be Riots. Would you like to see if there is anything more you can do for them?|1072|0
units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, you see a distinctive group of people lugging a collection of instruments: the band There Might Be Riots. Would you like to see if there is anything more you can do for them?
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, vedi un gruppo inconfondibile di persone che si trascina una collezione di strumenti: la band There Might Be Riots. Vuoi vedere se c'è qualcos'altro che puoi fare per loro?

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	(Yes.)|1074|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	(Not right now.)|1075|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	They're very happy to see you. "You always seem to have amazing timing," says Ulrich. "We were just wondering who could transport us to a... gig of sorts... up north, and then you come along. Any chance you could take us to <destination>?"|1077|0
units.english: They're very happy to see you. "You always seem to have amazing timing," says Ulrich. "We were just wondering who could transport us to a... gig of sorts... up north, and then you come along. Any chance you could take us to <destination>?"
units.italian: Sono molto felici di vederti. "Hai sempre un tempismo incredibile," dice Ulrich. "Ci stavamo giusto chiedendo chi potesse portarci a un... concerto, diciamo... a nord, e poi arrivi tu. Per caso potresti portarci su <destination>?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	You've heard of that planet. "The weapons testing world for Lovelace Labs?" you ask. "I'm surprised you'd be able to find a big audience there."|1078|0
units.english: You've heard of that planet. "The weapons testing world for Lovelace Labs?" you ask. "I'm surprised you'd be able to find a big audience there."
units.italian: Hai sentito parlare di quel pianeta. "Il mondo di prova delle armi dei Lovelace Labs?" chiedi. "Mi sorprende che possiate trovare un grande pubblico lì."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Oh, we'll have an audience, all right," he says. "We've just put out a new album called 'Songs for the End of Civilization.' A war protest album. We want to film ourselves playing a concert right in the middle of the missile testing range. Of course, we'll probably end up running out of there with Republic Intelligence nipping at our heels. What do you say?"|1079|0
units.english: "Oh, we'll have an audience, all right," he says. "We've just put out a new album called 'Songs for the End of Civilization.' A war protest album. We want to film ourselves playing a concert right in the middle of the missile testing range. Of course, we'll probably end up running out of there with Republic Intelligence nipping at our heels. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Oh, il pubblico lo avremo, eccome," dice. "Abbiamo appena pubblicato un nuovo album, 'Songs for the End of Civilization'. Un album di protesta contro la guerra. Vogliamo filmarci mentre suoniamo un concerto proprio in mezzo al poligono di lancio dei missili. Certo, probabilmente finiremo per scappare da lì con l'Intelligence della Repubblica alle calcagna. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Sounds like a worthy cause. Count me in!"|1081|0
units.english: "Sounds like a worthy cause. Count me in!"
units.italian: "Sembra una causa degna. Ci sto!"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"You're going to do a concert on ground that could be littered with unexploded ordnance?"|1083|0
units.english: "You're going to do a concert on ground that could be littered with unexploded ordnance?"
units.italian: "Vuoi fare un concerto su un terreno che potrebbe essere disseminato di ordigni inesplosi?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Sorry, that's further than I'm willing to go for you guys."|1084|0
units.english: "Sorry, that's further than I'm willing to go for you guys."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, è più in là di dove sono disposto ad arrivare per voi."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Yeah. What an adventure!" he says. "Come on, it will be worth it."|1086|0
units.english: "Yeah. What an adventure!" he says. "Come on, it will be worth it."
units.italian: "Sì. Che avventura!" dice. "Dai, ne varrà la pena."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Sounds like a worthy cause. Count me in!"|1088|0
units.english: "Sounds like a worthy cause. Count me in!"
units.italian: "È una causa giusta. Contami dentro!"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Sorry, that's further than I'm willing to go for you guys."|1090|0
units.english: "Sorry, that's further than I'm willing to go for you guys."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma per voi non vado fino a quel punto."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Are you sure?" he asks. "We'll pay you with more than just money. Do this for us, and I'll share a story with you that very few have heard."|1093|0
units.english: "Are you sure?" he asks. "We'll pay you with more than just money. Do this for us, and I'll share a story with you that very few have heard."
units.italian: "Ne sei sicuro?" chiede. "Ti pagheremo con più che semplici soldi. Fai questo per noi, e ti racconterò una storia che ben pochi hanno sentito."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Sorry, but it's still a 'no.'"|1095|0
units.english: "Sorry, but it's still a 'no.'"
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma resta un 'no'."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Okay, I'm intrigued. But it still sounds risky."|1097|0
units.english: "Okay, I'm intrigued. But it still sounds risky."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono incuriosito. Ma sembra comunque rischioso."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Great," he says. "Now, the only question is where we'll go afterwards until the fuss dies down. Say, did you ever find that planet of squirrel people? We'd love to go back there."|1101|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "Now, the only question is where we'll go afterwards until the fuss dies down. Say, did you ever find that planet of squirrel people? We'd love to go back there."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Ora, l'unica domanda è dove andremo dopo, finché il putiferio non si calma. Di', ma hai mai trovato quel pianeta di gente scoiattolo? Ci piacerebbe tornarci."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Yes," you say, "they're called the Hai. They live in a whole big region to the north."|1102|0
units.english: "Yes," you say, "they're called the Hai. They live in a whole big region to the north."
units.italian: "Sì," dici, "si chiamano Hai. Vivono in un'intera grande regione a nord."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Great," he says. "Now, the only question is where we'll go afterwards until the fuss dies down. I was thinking it'd be a great chance for our band to reconnect with the squirrel people - what did you call them?"|1105|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "Now, the only question is where we'll go afterwards until the fuss dies down. I was thinking it'd be a great chance for our band to reconnect with the squirrel people - what did you call them?"
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Ora, l'unica domanda è dove andremo dopo, finché il polverone non si sgonfia. Pensavo che sarebbe una bella occasione per la nostra band di riallacciare i rapporti con il popolo scoiattolo... come li hai chiamati?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"The Hai," you say.|1106|0
units.english: "The Hai," you say.
units.italian: "Gli Hai," dici.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	"Excellent," he says. "We go thumb our noses at the military-industrial complex, then you take us to stay with the peaceful squirrel people where the government won't bother us."|1108|0
units.english: "Excellent," he says. "We go thumb our noses at the military-industrial complex, then you take us to stay with the peaceful squirrel people where the government won't bother us."
units.italian: "Eccellente," dice. "Andiamo a fare un dispetto al complesso militare-industriale, e poi tu ci porti a stare con il pacifico popolo scoiattolo, dove il governo non ci darà fastidio."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|	Once more, they begin loading their stuff onto your ship, while you chart a course to <destination>.|1109|0
units.english: Once more, they begin loading their stuff onto your ship, while you chart a course to <destination>.
units.italian: Ancora una volta cominciano a caricare le loro cose sulla nave, mentre tu tracci una rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3A|dialog|1112|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the band and their supplies has not arrived yet. Better depart and wait for your escorts to enter the system.
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta che porta la band e le sue attrezzature non è ancora arrivata. Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte entrino nel sistema.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|name|1118|0
units.english: Transport band to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta la band su <planet>

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|description|1119|0
units.english: Avoid the Navy combat drones and give the band "There Might Be Riots" a ride to <destination>.
units.italian: Evita i droni da combattimento della Marina e porta la band "There Might Be Riots" fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|You bring your ship to a gingerly landing in a section of the testing range that doesn't look too pockmarked with craters, and the band begins setting up their equipment and video cameras. "This is great," says Ulrich. "We'll be broadcasting live over the Net. It's time people started asking why the government thinks it needs all these weapons of war."|1129|0
units.english: You bring your ship to a gingerly landing in a section of the testing range that doesn't look too pockmarked with craters, and the band begins setting up their equipment and video cameras. "This is great," says Ulrich. "We'll be broadcasting live over the Net. It's time people started asking why the government thinks it needs all these weapons of war."
units.italian: Porti la nave a un atterraggio cauto in una zona del poligono che non sembra troppo butterata di crateri, e la band comincia a montare le attrezzature e le telecamere. "È fantastico," dice Ulrich. "Trasmetteremo in diretta sulla Rete. È ora che la gente cominci a chiedersi perché il governo pensi di aver bisogno di tutte queste armi da guerra."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	The band plays through about a third of their set without any evidence that the locals even know you are here, which is surprising for such a tightly secured planet. Then, right in the middle of a particularly crunchy anti-war song, your long-range radar picks up something: a large number of ships approaching from a hundred kilometers away.|1130|0
units.english: The band plays through about a third of their set without any evidence that the locals even know you are here, which is surprising for such a tightly secured planet. Then, right in the middle of a particularly crunchy anti-war song, your long-range radar picks up something: a large number of ships approaching from a hundred kilometers away.
units.italian: La band suona circa un terzo del suo repertorio senza alcun segno che i locali sappiano nemmeno che siete lì, il che è sorprendente per un pianeta così strettamente sorvegliato. Poi, proprio nel mezzo di una canzone contro la guerra particolarmente ruvida, il tuo radar a lungo raggio capta qualcosa: un gran numero di navi in avvicinamento da cento chilometri di distanza.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"Guys, I think we should get out of here."|1132|0
units.english: "Guys, I think we should get out of here."
units.italian: "Ragazzi, credo che dovremmo andarcene."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"We've got ships incoming. Could be trouble."|1133|0
units.english: "We've got ships incoming. Could be trouble."
units.italian: "Abbiamo navi in arrivo. Potrebbe essere un problema."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	The band stops playing. Ulrich turns to the cameras and says, "For all our fans out there, we'll be back after a brief intermission." Then he walks over to you and says, "What is it?"|1135|0
units.english: The band stops playing. Ulrich turns to the cameras and says, "For all our fans out there, we'll be back after a brief intermission." Then he walks over to you and says, "What is it?"
units.italian: La band smette di suonare. Ulrich si volta verso le telecamere e dice: "A tutti i nostri fan là fuori, torniamo dopo un breve intervallo." Poi si avvicina a te e chiede: "Che succede?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"Ships incoming," you say.|1136|0
units.english: "Ships incoming," you say.
units.italian: "Navi in arrivo," dici.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	The band stops playing. Ulrich turns to the cameras and says, "For all our fans out there, we'll be back after a brief intermission." Then he walks over to you.|1139|0
units.english: The band stops playing. Ulrich turns to the cameras and says, "For all our fans out there, we'll be back after a brief intermission." Then he walks over to you.
units.italian: La band smette di suonare. Ulrich si gira verso le telecamere e dice: "A tutti i nostri fan là fuori, torneremo dopo un breve intervallo." Poi si avvicina a te.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"Did they hail us?" asks Ulrich.|1141|0
units.english: "Did they hail us?" asks Ulrich.
units.italian: "Ci hanno chiamato?" chiede Ulrich.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"No," you say.|1142|0
units.english: "No," you say.
units.italian: "No," dici.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	He swears, then shouts to the rest of the band, "Gentlemen, time to pack it up posthaste, before we get turned into a tragic industrial accident!"|1143|0
units.english: He swears, then shouts to the rest of the band, "Gentlemen, time to pack it up posthaste, before we get turned into a tragic industrial accident!"
units.italian: Impreca, poi grida al resto della band: "Signori, è ora di fare i bagagli in fretta e furia, prima che ci trasformino in un tragico incidente industriale!"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	The band has just packed the last of their equipment away when the ships come into view. It's a swarm of unpiloted combat drones, and they seem to be engaged in mock combat with each other. But, their flight path is taking them straight in your direction. You power up your shields just as the first of the drones decide that your ship is a valid target for their lasers...|1144|0
units.english: The band has just packed the last of their equipment away when the ships come into view. It's a swarm of unpiloted combat drones, and they seem to be engaged in mock combat with each other. But, their flight path is taking them straight in your direction. You power up your shields just as the first of the drones decide that your ship is a valid target for their lasers...
units.italian: La band ha appena finito di riporre l'ultima attrezzatura quando le navi arrivano in vista. È uno sciame di droni da combattimento senza pilota, e sembrano impegnati in un combattimento simulato tra loro. Ma la loro traiettoria li porta dritti verso di te. Attivi gli scudi proprio quando i primi droni decidono che la tua nave è un bersaglio valido per i loro laser...

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|dialog|1167|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the band and their supplies has not arrived yet. Better depart and wait for your escorts to enter the system.
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta che porta la band e le sue attrezzature non è ancora arrivata. Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte entrino nel sistema.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|log|1170|0
units.english: Brought "There Might Be Riots" to the Hai world of Allhome after escaping a swarm of combat drones that disrupted their performance on Pilot. Ulrich spoke of a cloudy star in the Rim where he heard a voice in his head after parking his ship.
units.italian: Hai portato "There Might Be Riots" sul mondo Hai di Allhome dopo essere sfuggito a uno sciame di droni da combattimento che ha interrotto la loro esibizione su Pilot. Ulrich ha parlato di una stella nuvolosa nel Rim dove ha sentito una voce nella testa dopo aver parcheggiato la nave.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|You drop off There Might Be Riots on Allhome. Ulrich is looking around the spaceport in wide-eyed excitement. "This is it, guys!" he says. "We're back in the land of the peaceful squirrels. Captain <last>, I don't know how to thank you, but here's a start." He hands you <payment>.|1172|0
units.english: You drop off There Might Be Riots on Allhome. Ulrich is looking around the spaceport in wide-eyed excitement. "This is it, guys!" he says. "We're back in the land of the peaceful squirrels. Captain <last>, I don't know how to thank you, but here's a start." He hands you <payment>.
units.italian: Lasci There Might Be Riots su Allhome. Ulrich si guarda intorno nello spazioporto con eccitazione infantile. "Ci siamo, ragazzi!" dice. "Siamo tornati nella terra degli scoiattoli pacifici. Capitano <last>, non so come ringraziarla, ma ecco un inizio." Ti consegna <payment>.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	As the rest of the band begins unloading their things, Ulrich adds speaking more quietly, "And, in good minstrel fashion I will pay you not just with money, but with a story.|1173|0
units.english: As the rest of the band begins unloading their things, Ulrich adds speaking more quietly, "And, in good minstrel fashion I will pay you not just with money, but with a story.
units.italian: Mentre il resto della band comincia a scaricare le loro cose, Ulrich aggiunge, parlando più piano: "E, da buon menestrello, ti pagherò non solo con i soldi, ma con una storia.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"Back when the fame first became too much for me, I rented a shuttlecraft under an assumed name and went tooling around the galaxy just to get away from it all. I found some cloudy star out along the Rim, parked my ship where no one would bother me, shut down everything but life support, and just sat there meditating and enjoying the silence for two or three days.|1174|0
units.english: "Back when the fame first became too much for me, I rented a shuttlecraft under an assumed name and went tooling around the galaxy just to get away from it all. I found some cloudy star out along the Rim, parked my ship where no one would bother me, shut down everything but life support, and just sat there meditating and enjoying the silence for two or three days.
units.italian: "Quando la fama ha cominciato a diventare troppo per me, noleggiai uno shuttle sotto falso nome e me ne andai in giro per la galassia solo per allontanarmi da tutto. Trovai una stella nuvolosa lungo il Rim, parcheggiai la nave dove nessuno mi avrebbe disturbato, spensi tutto tranne il supporto vitale, e me ne restai seduto lì a meditare e a godermi il silenzio per due o tre giorni.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"Then suddenly clear as day I heard a voice say, 'Are you okay? Do you need anything?' I was so shocked that without even thinking I said, 'I'm fine. How about you?' And the voice told me he was sad. Sad, because that part of space used to be the home of another species, and now they're all dead. He said we humans built our cities on the graveyards of a great civilization and didn't even know it. And if we didn't stop fighting each other, our species would die off too.|1175|0
units.english: "Then suddenly clear as day I heard a voice say, 'Are you okay? Do you need anything?' I was so shocked that without even thinking I said, 'I'm fine. How about you?' And the voice told me he was sad. Sad, because that part of space used to be the home of another species, and now they're all dead. He said we humans built our cities on the graveyards of a great civilization and didn't even know it. And if we didn't stop fighting each other, our species would die off too.
units.italian: "Poi all'improvviso, chiaro come il giorno, sentii una voce dire: 'Stai bene? Ti serve qualcosa?' Ero così scosso che senza nemmeno pensarci dissi: 'Sto bene. E tu?' E la voce mi disse che era triste. Triste, perché quella parte di spazio era un tempo la casa di un'altra specie, e ora sono tutti morti. Disse che noi umani abbiamo costruito le nostre città sui cimiteri di una grande civiltà, e non lo sapevamo nemmeno. E che se non avessimo smesso di combattere tra noi, anche la nostra specie si sarebbe estinta.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"That's when the band started to speak out against war."|1176|0
units.english: "That's when the band started to speak out against war."
units.italian: "È stato allora che la band ha cominciato a parlare contro la guerra."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"Do you think the voice was real, or just in your head?"|1178|0
units.english: "Do you think the voice was real, or just in your head?"
units.italian: "Credi che la voce fosse reale, o solo nella tua testa?"

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"It sounds like a good warning. I'll try to take it to heart."|1179|0
units.english: "It sounds like a good warning. I'll try to take it to heart."
units.italian: "Sembra un buon avvertimento. Cercherò di tenerlo a mente."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"It was in my head," he says, "And it was real. Very real. When it spoke I felt like the whole galaxy had just tipped sideways, or like I'd just stepped too close to the edge of a cliff and got vertigo. I've imagined some crazy things, but I tell you, this I did not imagine."|1181|0
units.english: "It was in my head," he says, "And it was real. Very real. When it spoke I felt like the whole galaxy had just tipped sideways, or like I'd just stepped too close to the edge of a cliff and got vertigo. I've imagined some crazy things, but I tell you, this I did not imagine."
units.italian: "Era nella mia testa," dice, "ed era reale. Molto reale. Quando ha parlato mi sono sentito come se l'intera galassia si fosse inclinata di lato, o come se mi fossi appena sporto troppo oltre l'orlo di una scogliera e avessi preso le vertigini. Mi sono immaginato cose assurde, ma ti giuro, questa non me la sono immaginata."

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	You wish him the best of luck in Hai space, and he heads off into the spaceport with the rest of the band.|1182|0
units.english: You wish him the best of luck in Hai space, and he heads off into the spaceport with the rest of the band.
units.italian: Gli auguri ogni fortuna nello spazio degli Hai, e lui si incammina nello spazioporto con il resto della band.

units.id: mission:There Might Be Riots part 3B|	"Then best of luck to you," he says, and he heads off into the spaceport with the rest of the band.|1185|0
units.english: "Then best of luck to you," he says, and he heads off into the spaceport with the rest of the band.
units.italian: "Allora buona fortuna a te," dice, e si incammina nello spazioporto con il resto della band.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 1|name|1191|0
units.english: Drug Running
units.italian: Contrabbando di droga

units.id: mission:Drug Running 1|description|1192|0
units.english: Bring a shipment of <cargo> to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with this cargo, you may be fined.
units.italian: Porta una partita di <cargo> su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà di <payment>. Se vieni scoperto con questo carico, potresti ricevere una multa.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 1|illegal|1202|0
units.english: In addition to the fine, the illegal drugs are confiscated from your cargo hold.
units.italian: Oltre alla multa, le droghe illegali vengono confiscate dalla stiva.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 1|dialog|1209|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, a man pulls you aside and asks if you would like to help transport <tons> of "recreational pharmaceuticals" to <planet> for <payment>. (This sounds like an illegal mission, so you'll need to avoid getting scanned or landing on planets with high security.)
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, un uomo ti tira da parte e chiede se vuoi aiutare a trasportare <tons> di "farmaci ricreativi" su <planet> per <payment>. (Sembra una missione illegale, quindi dovrai evitare di essere scansionato o di atterrare su pianeti con alta sicurezza.)

units.id: mission:Drug Running 1|dialog|1222|0
units.english: Some disreputable-looking locals unload the illegal drugs from your cargo bay, and hand you your payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Alcuni locali dall'aria poco raccomandabile scaricano le droghe illegali dalla stiva e ti consegnano il tuo pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 2|name|1227|0
units.english: Drug Running
units.italian: Contrabbando di droga

units.id: mission:Drug Running 2|description|1228|0
units.english: Bring a shipment of <cargo> to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with this cargo, you may be fined.
units.italian: Porta una partita di <cargo> su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà di <payment>. Se vieni scoperto con questo carico, potresti ricevere una multa.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 2|illegal|1238|0
units.english: In addition to the fine, the illegal drugs are confiscated from your cargo hold.
units.italian: Oltre alla multa, le droghe illegali vengono confiscate dalla stiva.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 2|dialog|1245|0
units.english: When you walk into the local bar, a man sitting in the corner waves you over and says in a hushed voice, "Captain, we've got <tons> of the good stuff that needs to get to <planet>. I promise you this will be a very lucrative operation. What do you say?"
units.italian: Quando entri nel bar del posto, un uomo seduto nell'angolo ti fa cenno di avvicinarti e dice a voce bassa: "Capitano, abbiamo <tons> di roba buona che deve arrivare su <planet>. Le prometto che sarà un'operazione molto redditizia. Che ne dice?"

units.id: mission:Drug Running 2|dialog|1253|0
units.english: Immediately after you land, some workers show up to unload the "stuff." They give you <payment>.
units.italian: Subito dopo che sei atterrato, arrivano alcuni lavoratori a scaricare la "roba". Ti danno <payment>.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 3|name|1258|0
units.english: Drug Running
units.italian: Contrabbando di droga

units.id: mission:Drug Running 3|description|1259|0
units.english: Bring a shipment of <cargo> to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with this cargo, you may be fined.
units.italian: Porta una partita di <cargo> su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà di <payment>. Se vieni scoperto con questo carico, potresti ricevere una multa.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 3|illegal|1269|0
units.english: In addition to the fine, the illegal drugs are confiscated from your cargo hold.
units.italian: Oltre alla multa, le droghe illegali vengono confiscate dalla stiva.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 3|dialog|1276|0
units.english: A well-dressed woman approaches you as you are walking through the spaceport and asks quietly if you would be willing to help facilitate the transport of some "naughty substances" to a certain individual on <planet> for <payment>.
units.italian: Una donna ben vestita ti si avvicina mentre attraversi lo spazioporto e chiede sottovoce se saresti disposto ad aiutare a facilitare il trasporto di alcune "sostanze birichine" a un certo individuo su <planet> per <payment>.

units.id: mission:Drug Running 3|dialog|1284|0
units.english: You hand off the illegal "substances" to your contact on <planet>, who pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Consegni le "sostanze" illegali al tuo contatto su <planet>, che ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Hallucination|During your brief stop on <origin>, it occurs to you that it really is a shame to have a cargo hold full of the finest of illegal drugs, and not to take even a small sample for yourself. There is no way the loss of a tiny bit of drugs could be noticed. Give it a try?|1352|0
units.english: During your brief stop on <origin>, it occurs to you that it really is a shame to have a cargo hold full of the finest of illegal drugs, and not to take even a small sample for yourself. There is no way the loss of a tiny bit of drugs could be noticed. Give it a try?
units.italian: Durante la breve sosta su <origin>, ti viene in mente che è davvero un peccato avere una stiva piena delle migliori droghe illegali e non prenderne nemmeno un piccolo campione per te. Non c'è modo che si noti la mancanza di una quantità minima. Vuoi provarci?

units.id: mission:Hallucination|	(No, I never touch that stuff.)|1354|0
units.english: (No, I never touch that stuff.)
units.italian: (No, non tocco mai quella roba.)

units.id: mission:Hallucination|	(Sure, sounds like fun!)|1356|0
units.english: (Sure, sounds like fun!)
units.italian: (Certo, sembra divertente!)

units.id: mission:Hallucination|	The room begins to spin, and strange things happen...|1357|0
units.english: The room begins to spin, and strange things happen...
units.italian: La stanza comincia a girare, e succedono cose strane...

units.id: mission:Hallucination|log|1361|0
units.english: Agreed to transport illegal drugs. Tried some of them while refueling and instantly regretted it. The sky truly is endless.
units.italian: Hai accettato di trasportare droghe illegali. Ne hai provate un po' mentre facevi rifornimento e te ne sei pentito all'istante. Il cielo è davvero senza fine.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 1|name|1377|0
units.english: Shady passenger transport
units.italian: Trasporto passeggeri losco

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 1|description|1378|0
units.english: Discreetly transport a passenger to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with him, you may be fined.
units.italian: Trasporta discretamente un passeggero su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà di <payment>. Se vieni scoperto con lui, potresti ricevere una multa.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 1|illegal|1389|0
units.english: Your passenger turns out to be a small-time wanted criminal. As he is hauled off in chains, you vehemently protest that you knew nothing of his shady history. You wind up quite a bit poorer through a combination of fines and bribes (the breakdown remains somewhat unclear).
units.italian: Il tuo passeggero si rivela un piccolo criminale ricercato. Mentre lo portano via in catene, protesti con veemenza di non sapere nulla del suo passato losco. Finisci molto più povero per una combinazione di multe e tangenti (il conto resta piuttosto poco chiaro).

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 1|dialog|1397|0
units.english: While having a drink at one of the spaceport's bars, a somewhat scruffy-looking man in a dark cloak pulls you aside and offers <payment> for discreet, no-questions-asked passage to <destination>, which is quite close by. This could be a quick and lucrative job. (It also sounds illegal, so you'll need to avoid getting scanned or landing on planets with high security.)
units.italian: Mentre bevi qualcosa in uno dei bar dello spazioporto, un uomo dall'aria un po' trasandata, avvolto in un mantello scuro, ti tira da parte e offre <payment> per un passaggio discreto e senza domande fino a <destination>, che è piuttosto vicina. Potrebbe essere un lavoro rapido e redditizio. (Sembra anche illegale, quindi dovrai evitare di essere scansionato o di atterrare su pianeti con alta sicurezza.)

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 1|dialog|1410|0
units.english: Your mysterious passenger has spoken hardly a word during the entire trip. As soon as you land, he hands you your payment of <payment> and disappears into a crowd.
units.italian: Il tuo misterioso passeggero ha parlato a malapena per tutto il viaggio. Appena atterri, ti consegna il tuo pagamento di <payment> e sparisce in mezzo alla folla.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 2|name|1415|0
units.english: Shady passenger transport
units.italian: Trasporto passeggeri losco

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 2|description|1416|0
units.english: Discreetly transport two passengers to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with them, you may be fined.
units.italian: Trasporta discretamente due passeggeri su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà di <payment>. Se vieni scoperto con loro, potresti ricevere una multa.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 2|illegal|1427|0
units.english: Your passengers turn out to be wanted criminals. As they are hauled off in chains, you vehemently protest that you knew nothing of their shady histories. You wind up quite a bit poorer through a combination of fines and bribes (the breakdown remains somewhat unclear).
units.italian: I tuoi passeggeri si rivelano criminali ricercati. Mentre li portano via in catene, protesti con veemenza di non sapere nulla dei loro passati loschi. Finisci molto più povero per una combinazione di multe e tangenti (il conto resta piuttosto poco chiaro).

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 2|dialog|1436|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, two men in nondescript clothing appear out of nowhere and offer <payment> for discreet, no-questions-asked passage to <destination>. Though they say very little, you get the distinct sense that their presence on this planet and motivation to be elsewhere may not be entirely legal.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, due uomini in abiti anonimi spuntano dal nulla e offrono <payment> per un passaggio discreto e senza domande fino a <destination>. Per quanto parlino pochissimo, hai la netta sensazione che la loro presenza su questo pianeta e la loro voglia di essere altrove non siano del tutto legali.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 2|dialog|1441|0
units.english: You bundle the men onto your ship before anyone sees them. As you're helping unpack their luggage, one of them casually mentions that they may have attracted the attention of some bounty hunters, and would prefer not to be captured. You should probably avoid being scanned, too.
units.italian: Fai salire i due sulla nave prima che qualcuno li veda. Mentre li aiuti a scaricare i bagagli, uno di loro accenna con noncuranza che potrebbero aver attirato l'attenzione di alcuni cacciatori di taglie, e preferirebbero non essere catturati. Probabilmente faresti bene a evitare anche tu di farti scansionare.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 2|dialog|1451|0
units.english: Your passengers depart after paying you the agreed-upon sum of <payment>, off to make new lives for themselves doing who-knows-what.
units.italian: I tuoi passeggeri se ne vanno dopo aver pagato la somma concordata di <payment>, pronti a farsi una nuova vita facendo chissà cosa.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3|name|1463|0
units.english: Shady passenger transport
units.italian: Trasporto passeggeri losco

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3|description|1464|0
units.english: Discreetly transport <bunks> passengers to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with them, the legal consequences may be severe.
units.italian: Trasporta discretamente <bunks> passeggeri su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà di <payment>. Se vieni scoperto con loro, le conseguenze legali potrebbero essere gravi.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3|illegal|1474|0
units.english: It's difficult to feign ignorance of your passengers' background during your questioning. You wind up having to pay a small fortune in fines and bribes to keep yourself from being charged as an accomplice to some very serious-sounding crimes.
units.italian: È difficile fingere di ignorare il passato dei tuoi passeggeri durante l'interrogatorio. Finisci per dover pagare una piccola fortuna in multe e tangenti per evitare di essere accusato come complice di crimini che suonano molto gravi.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3|dialog|1484|0
units.english: A group of <bunks> fearsome-looking young men and women brazenly walk up to you in broad daylight, explaining that they're in some legal trouble and need to get to <destination> as quickly as possible. They offer <payment> to secure discreet passage. You must be getting quite a reputation in certain circles. Transporting them might be very dangerous. On the other hand, they're offering a small fortune...
units.italian: Un gruppo di <bunks> giovani uomini e donne dall'aria feroce ti si avvicina spudoratamente in pieno giorno, spiegando che hanno qualche problema legale e devono arrivare su <destination> il più in fretta possibile. Offrono <payment> per assicurarsi un passaggio discreto. Vuol dire che in certi ambienti la tua reputazione ti precede. Trasportarli potrebbe essere molto pericoloso. D'altra parte offrono una piccola fortuna...

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3|dialog|1487|0
units.english: The mercenaries (or gang members, or fleeing bank robbers, or who knows what else) make themselves at home on your ship, and begin drinking and arguing. You wonder what you've gotten yourself into...
units.italian: I mercenari (o membri di una banda, o rapinatori di banca in fuga, o chissà cos'altro) si mettono comodi sulla nave e cominciano a bere e a litigare. Ti chiedi in cosa ti sia cacciato...

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3|dialog|1497|0
units.english: During the voyage, you've come to understand that your passengers are mercenaries whose latest exploits put them on the wrong side of the law. They pay you the agreed-upon sum of <payment> and disappear into a crowd, no doubt off to cause chaos and mayhem for some unsuspecting victims. Oh well, not your problem...
units.italian: Durante il viaggio hai capito che i tuoi passeggeri sono mercenari le cui ultime imprese li hanno messi dalla parte sbagliata della legge. Ti pagano la somma concordata di <payment> e spariscono tra la folla, senza dubbio pronti a portare caos e distruzione a qualche vittima ignara. Pazienza, non è un tuo problema...

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|name|1521|0
units.english: Shady passenger transport
units.italian: Trasporto passeggeri losco

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|description|1522|0
units.english: Discreetly transport <bunks> passengers to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with them, the legal consequences may be severe.
units.italian: Trasporta discretamente <bunks> passeggeri su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà di <payment>. Se vieni scoperto con loro, le conseguenze legali potrebbero essere gravi.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|dialog|1540|0
units.english: A group of <bunks> fearsome-looking young men and women brazenly walk up to you in broad daylight, explaining that they're in some legal trouble and need to get to <destination> as quickly as possible. They offer <payment> to secure discreet passage. You must be getting quite a reputation in certain circles. Transporting them might be very dangerous. On the other hand, they're offering a small fortune...
units.italian: Un gruppo di <bunks> giovani uomini e donne dall'aria feroce ti si avvicina senza alcun timore in pieno giorno, spiegando che hanno qualche guaio legale e devono arrivare su <destination> il più rapidamente possibile. Offrono <payment> per un passaggio discreto. Vuol dire che in certi ambienti hai già un certo nome. Trasportarli potrebbe essere molto rischioso. D'altro canto, offrono un bel gruzzolo...

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|dialog|1549|0
units.english: The mercenaries (or gang members, or fleeing bank robbers, or who knows what else) make themselves at home on your ship, and begin drinking and arguing. You wonder what you've gotten yourself into...
units.italian: I mercenari (o membri di una banda, o rapinatori di banca in fuga, o chissà cos'altro) si accomodano sulla nave come a casa loro e cominciano a bere e a discutere. Ti domandi in che pasticcio ti sei infilato...

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|You'd begun to doubt the wisdom of your decision to transport this band of cutthroats from the moment you agreed to it, but the money was too good to resist. You settle into the captain's chair and prepare for the voyage ahead.|1557|0
units.english: You'd begun to doubt the wisdom of your decision to transport this band of cutthroats from the moment you agreed to it, but the money was too good to resist. You settle into the captain's chair and prepare for the voyage ahead.
units.italian: Avevi cominciato a dubitare della saggezza della tua decisione di trasportare questa banda di tagliagole dal momento stesso in cui avevi accettato, ma il denaro era troppo buono per resistere. Ti sistemi nella poltrona del capitano e ti prepari al viaggio.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	But something feels wrong. You expect to hear the sounds of drunkenness and violence coming from the passenger compartment, but instead a deathly silence fills the air. You whirl around in your seat and come face-to-face with the entire gang. They're all armed. And their weapons are pointing at you. Your heart sinks.|1558|0
units.english: But something feels wrong. You expect to hear the sounds of drunkenness and violence coming from the passenger compartment, but instead a deathly silence fills the air. You whirl around in your seat and come face-to-face with the entire gang. They're all armed. And their weapons are pointing at you. Your heart sinks.
units.italian: Ma qualcosa non va. Ti aspetti di sentire i rumori dell'ubriachezza e della violenza provenire dal compartimento passeggeri, invece nell'aria c'è un silenzio di morte. Ti giri di scatto sulla poltrona e ti trovi faccia a faccia con l'intera banda. Sono tutti armati. E le loro armi sono puntate su di te. Il cuore ti sprofonda.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	Their leader appears to be a lithe and dangerous-looking young woman who holds an enormous shotgun that's almost as big as her. "Looks like we boarded the ship of fools, and here's the biggest one!" she says mockingly. "We didn't have a credit to our names, but soon we'll own your ship. Hand over the access codes and we'll let you live."|1559|0
units.english: Their leader appears to be a lithe and dangerous-looking young woman who holds an enormous shotgun that's almost as big as her. "Looks like we boarded the ship of fools, and here's the biggest one!" she says mockingly. "We didn't have a credit to our names, but soon we'll own your ship. Hand over the access codes and we'll let you live."
units.italian: La loro capa sembra essere una giovane donna snella e dall'aria pericolosa che impugna un fucile a canna liscia enorme, quasi grande quanto lei. "Pare che siamo saliti sulla nave degli stupidi, ed ecco il più grande di tutti!" dice con scherno. "Non avevamo un credito a testa, ma presto avremo la tua nave. Passa i codici di accesso e ti lasceremo vivere."

units.italian: Si rivela una decisione davvero pessima. Ed è anche l'ultima. Una scarica davvero eccessiva di proiettili mette fine alla tua vita.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	"You don't want my ship, you want my money," you stammer, stalling for time while you try to think of a way out of this situation. "This ship is registered to me; nobody would believe that you came across it honestly. You want a fresh start in an anonymous ship. I'll give you 4 million credits, and you can buy a Modified Argosy or some other vessel better suited to your line of work."|1577|0
units.english: "You don't want my ship, you want my money," you stammer, stalling for time while you try to think of a way out of this situation. "This ship is registered to me; nobody would believe that you came across it honestly. You want a fresh start in an anonymous ship. I'll give you 4 million credits, and you can buy a Modified Argosy or some other vessel better suited to your line of work."
units.italian: "Non volete la mia nave, volete i miei soldi," balbetti, guadagnando tempo mentre cerchi un modo per uscire da questa situazione. "Questa nave è registrata a me; nessuno crederebbe che l'abbiate trovata onestamente. Volete un nuovo inizio su una nave anonima. Vi do 4 milioni di crediti, e potete comprarvi un'Argosy Modificata o un'altra nave più adatta al vostro mestiere."

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	The gang leader snorts derisively. "Why don't we just kill you and hotwire this ship? That sounds more fun."|1578|0
units.english: The gang leader snorts derisively. "Why don't we just kill you and hotwire this ship? That sounds more fun."
units.italian: La capa della banda sbuffa con disprezzo. "E perché non ti ammazziamo e mettiamo in moto questa nave? Sembra più divertente."

units.italian: Alzi la tangente a 8 milioni di crediti. Basta. Un sospiro di sollievo ti sfugge dalle labbra mentre tutti abbassano le armi.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	You arrange for a merchant captain to transport the renegades down to the surface, along with a password-protected credit chip. units.english: You arrange for a merchant captain to transport the renegades down to the surface, along with a password-protected credit chip. Once the airlock closes, you send them the password. At least you have escaped with your life and your ship.
units.italian: Organizzi il trasporto dei rinnegati fino alla superficie con un capitano mercantile, insieme a un gettone di credito protetto da password. Appena il portello si chiude, gli mandi la password. Almeno te la sei cavata con la vita e con la nave.

units.italian: Vai alla stazione di sicurezza e consegni con amarezza i codici di accesso della nave.

units.english: "Smart move," the leader says. "Or was it? Now we don't need you alive for anything, do we?"
units.italian: "Mossa intelligente," dice la capa. "O forse no? Ora non ci servi più vivi, vero?"

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	She fires her shotgun into you from behind, and for a brief moment, you are treated to the sight of your internal organs splattered all over the console. It's the last thing you ever see.|1597|0
units.english: She fires her shotgun into you from behind, and for a brief moment, you are treated to the sight of your internal organs splattered all over the console. It's the last thing you ever see.
units.italian: Ti spara col fucile alle spalle, e per un breve istante ti viene offerto lo spettacolo delle tue viscere sparse su tutta la consolle. È l'ultima cosa che vedi.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|Somehow, miraculously, you manage to reach your gun before she fires. units.english: Somehow, miraculously, you manage to reach your gun before she fires. Perhaps it's the sheer brazenness of it - no one would expect someone staring down the barrels of half a dozen guns to actually draw against them. Nevertheless, you do, and it works.
units.italian: Per qualche miracolo riesci a raggiungere la pistola prima che lei spari. Forse è la sfacciataggine assoluta della cosa: nessuno si aspetterebbe che qualcuno con sei canne di fucile puntate addosso estragga davvero la pistola. Eppure lo fai, e funziona.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	Your first shot finds its mark, and the gang leader crumples to the floor. The other thugs shriek in alarm and begin to spray gunfire in all directions, but it's ineffective panic fire. Taking cover behind the armored captain's chair, you dispatch two more with well-aimed shots.|1602|0
units.english: Your first shot finds its mark, and the gang leader crumples to the floor. The other thugs shriek in alarm and begin to spray gunfire in all directions, but it's ineffective panic fire. Taking cover behind the armored captain's chair, you dispatch two more with well-aimed shots.
units.italian: Il tuo primo colpo va a segno, e la capa della banda crolla al suolo. Gli altri teppisti strillano di spavento e cominciano a sparare in tutte le direzioni, ma è fuoco di panico inefficace. Riparandoti dietro la poltrona corazzata del capitano, ne elimini altri due con colpi ben mirati.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|	The remaining goons attempt to flee, but your fingers find the button controlling the bridge door and it slams down before they can escape. They throw down their weapons and surrender. You toss them into the brig and decide that it might be a hoot to take them to their original destination as prisoners instead of passengers, and see if you can get a bounty for bringing them in.|1603|0
units.english: The remaining goons attempt to flee, but your fingers find the button controlling the bridge door and it slams down before they can escape. They throw down their weapons and surrender. You toss them into the brig and decide that it might be a hoot to take them to their original destination as prisoners instead of passengers, and see if you can get a bounty for bringing them in.
units.italian: I gorilla rimasti tentano la fuga, ma le tue dita trovano il pulsante della porta della plancia e questa si chiude di colpo prima che riescano a scappare. Gettano le armi e si arrendono. Li sbatti in cella e decidi che potrebbe essere divertente portarli alla loro destinazione originale come prigionieri invece che come passeggeri, e vedere se riesci a incassare una taglia consegnandoli.

units.id: mission:Shady passenger transport 3 - double cross|dialog|1608|0
units.english: You hand off your prisoners to the planetary authorities who gratefully take them into custody. It turns out that they were wanted, and there's a substantial bounty. You find yourself richer to the tune of <payment>.
units.italian: Consegni i prigionieri alle autorità planetarie, che li prendono in custodia con gratitudine. Si scopre che erano ricercati, e c'è una taglia sostanziosa. Ti ritrovi più ricco di <payment>.
